title: Ottawa Hop-On Hop-Off Sightseeing Tour
includes: Transport by double decker bus or trolley
Admissions to attractions and sites (not included)
Hotel pickup are before 9:30-9:45am ($5 payable to driver). Reservation must be done 24 hours prior (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: If you require hotel pickup (before 9:30-9:45am), please contact the supplier 24 hours prior to your reservation. Please note: this service is $5, payable to the driver at time of pick-up
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Perfect for first-time visitors, this city tour is a well-rounded introduction to Ottawa's attractions, leaving you with time in the day free to explore the city on your own.
